items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: I said, Andy, why didn't you go get it?

ctx.x: So a nurse came up. She said, what's the matter? I said, she had my mic. She said, oh, I'll get it for you. I said, thank you. I said, Andy, why didn't you go get it? I said, who, she could have that mic. I wasn't going up there. I mean, I wasn't poking fun, but I mean, I was afraid of them. And I wasn't going up there to prove it no mic.
You know, you forgot to tell us about Tom Albert. You were talking about Tom Albert.
